'''Kithaba''' was a famous [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]<ref name="CCG" /> who, by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> served as a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] [[Skiff guard/Legends|guard]]<ref name="RotJ" /> for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Jabba">{{CSWECite|II|130|Jabba the Hutt (Jabba Desilijic Tiure)}}</ref> He intended to escape his servitude to the Hutt to become a [[Musician/Legends|musician]], that is before disposing of a few more of Jabba's prisoners.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|220|Kithaba}}</ref>

Wielding a [[Vibrostaff/Legends|vibro-staff]],<ref name="Chee27">{{Blog|holocron|27/comments|Jabba's Skiff Guards}}</ref> Kithaba was onboard the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|skiff]] carrying Jabba's [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] captives [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] as they were brought to be fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] inhabiting the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Pit of Carkoon]]. Skywalker escaped, and in the ensuing [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|battle]], Kithaba was the first of the skiff's guards to fall. Despite his struggling to survive, he was eventually seized by the sarlacc's tentacles and [[Death/Legends|devoured]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Kithaba rose to challenging situations.<ref name="CCG" />

==Equiqment==
Kithaba wore a red bandana and a tan vest. He wielded a [[Vibrostaff/Legends|vibro-staff]] during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kithaba_death.png|thumb|left|Kithaba is dragged into the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc's]] mouth.]]

The [[1983]] [[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars:'' Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] by [[James Kahn]] identifies a no-nonsense, [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-carrying guard aboard the prisoners' skiff as "Barada".<ref name="ROTJn">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'' Episode VI: ''Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]] later established this individual to be the first guard to fall from the skiff in the film, though he confirmed his name to be "Kithaba,"<ref name="Chee29">{{Blog|holocron|29/comments|Mistaken Identities}}</ref> as introduced in [[1998]] by the ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG" /> Kithaba and [[Barada/Legends|Barada]], a separate character, were also conflated in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|databank]], which included an image of the former in the latter's entry.<ref name="Chee29" />

The original [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] Barada action figure was sculpted to look like the character of that name, but was painted to resemble Kithaba. In [[2012]], an action figure bearing Kithaba's name and likeness was released in [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|''The Vintage Collection'']] line, available with either a red or black bandana.<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#056: Kithaba (Skiff Guard)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/VC56_KITHABA.asp}}</ref>
